integrity: All mathematical derivations and finite verifier code are self-contained. Exhaustive tests over three prime fields and an independently implemented nine-element extension field corroborate but do not certify the infinite-family theorem.
scientific_limitations: Odd-characteristic finite fields, nonzero off-diagonal bilinear parameter and the stated three-dimensional family only; general bilinear orthogonality literature may affect publication priority. Independent external validation has not been performed.
title: Three zero-bracket graph types in a finite Heisenberg–Leibniz family
